description: Test suite for HonoConnection implementation, verifying connection management, link creation, error handling, reconnection logic, and event handlers.

classes.name: HonoConnectionImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for HonoConnectionImpl, testing connection lifecycle, reconnection, link creation, error scenarios, and handler behavior.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, mocks Vertx and ProtonConnection, and sets up HonoConnectionImpl instance.

methods.name: testConnectFailsAfterMaxConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Verifies that connection fails after the maximum number of retries.

methods.name: testReconnectDelay
methods.description: Checks if the delay between reconnection attempts matches configured min/max/increment delays.

methods.name: testConnectFailsWithClientErrorForTransientSaslSystemException
methods.description: Ensures that transient SASL errors cause connection failure with correct error code.

methods.name: testDownstreamDisconnectTriggersReconnect
methods.description: Simulates downstream disconnection and verifies reconnection attempts.

methods.name: testConnectTriesToReconnectOnFailedConnectAttempt
methods.description: Asserts multiple connection retries until success.

methods.name: testOnRemoteCloseTriggersReconnection
methods.description: Tests that remote close triggers reconnection logic and listener invocation.

methods.name: testConnectFailsAfterShutdown
methods.description: Ensures no reconnect attempts are made after client shutdown.

methods.name: testConnectSucceedsAfterDisconnect
methods.description: Validates that reconnect succeeds after an explicit disconnect.

methods.name: testIsConnectedWithTimeoutSucceedsAfterConcurrentReconnectSucceeded
methods.description: Checks that concurrent isConnected calls resolve correctly after successful reconnect.

methods.name: testIsConnectedWithTimeoutFailsAfterConcurrentReconnectFailed
methods.description: Verifies that isConnected futures fail correctly when reconnect fails.

methods.name: testClientDoesNotTriggerReconnectionAfterShutdown
methods.description: Confirms no reconnection attempts are made post-shutdown.

methods.name: testCloseHandlerCallsCloseHook
methods.description: Verifies close hook invocation on receiver link close.

methods.name: testDetachHandlerCallsCloseHook
methods.description: Verifies detach hook invocation on receiver link detach.

methods.name: testHandlerCallsCloseHook
methods.description: Helper for testing handler callbacks invoking close hooks.

methods.name: testCreateReceiverFailsForErrorCondition
methods.description: Tests receiver creation failure when remote sends error condition.

methods.name: testCreateReceiverFailsWithoutErrorCondition
methods.description: Tests receiver creation failure when remote refuses link without error condition.

methods.name: testCreateReceiverFails
methods.description: Helper testing receiver creation failure scenarios.

methods.name: testCreateReceiverFailsOnTimeout
methods.description: Verifies receiver creation times out correctly if peer doesn't respond in time.

methods.name: testCreateSenderFailsForErrorCondition
methods.description: Tests sender creation failure when remote sends error condition.

methods.name: testCreateSenderFailsWithoutErrorCondition
methods.description: Tests sender creation failure when remote refuses without error condition.

methods.name: testCreateSenderFails
methods.description: Helper for testing sender creation failure scenarios.

methods.name: testCreateSenderFailsOnTimeout
methods.description: Checks that sender creation times out properly if peer doesn't respond.

methods.name: testCreateSenderFailsForUnsupportedAnonTerminus
methods.description: Ensures creation fails when target address is null and link is unsupported.

methods.name: testCreateSenderFailsIfPeerDoesNotCreateTerminus
methods.description: Tests failure when remote link does not assign a target address in attach.

methods.name: testCreateSenderThatGetsNoCredits
methods.description: Checks behavior when sender never receives credits after creation.

methods.name: testCreateSenderThatGetsDelayedCredits
methods.description: Verifies that sender credits within flowLatency are handled correctly.
